schema-version: The version of the schema used for this configuration file.
index: The main index file to be processed by perla, this file should be outside of the static mounted paths.
useLocalPkgs: Whether to use local packages or not, if set to true, perla will use the local packages in the node_modules directory.
provider: Which CDN use to pull your app's dependencies from (jspm, unpkg, jsdelivr).
plugins: The list of plugins to use by perla. For projects that use non-standard web browser features, you should provide the 'perla-esbuild-plugin' plugin to enable esbuild transformations.
mountDirectories: A key/value object that signals that the server path should find sources in the specified path e.g. '/server':'./relative/path'.
enableEnv: Enable providing environmental variables at dev time.
envPath: Select the rooted url where to serve the env vars for perla e.g /my-api/env.js.
dependencies: A Record of dependencies of this project, the key is the package name and the value is the version of the package, this is used to generate an import map for the browser.
fable.project: A relative path to the Fable project to compile.
fable.extension: The extension to use for compiled js files.
fable.outDir: A relative path that tells to output the js files.
fable.autoStart: [DEPRECATED] Enable/Disable the Fable compilation at the start of the dev server.
devServer: Configuration options for the saturn server running on the background at dev time.
devServer.host: A host to bind the dev server to, defaults to localhost.
devServer.port: A port to listen connections at for the dev server.
devServer.useSSL: Enable SSL and HSTS for Local development.
devServer.proxy: A mapping object between browser URLs -> Server URL for development.
devServer.autoStart: [DEPRECATED] Enable/Disable the saturn server auto start feature.
devServer.mountDirectories: [DEPRECATED] A key/value object that mounts the physical path specified by the key on the route specified by the value.
devServer.enableEnv: [DEPRECATED] Enable providing environmental variables at dev time.
devServer.envPath: [DEPRECATED] Select the rooted url where to serve the env vars for perla e.g /my-api/env.js.
devServer.watchConfig: [DEPRECATED] Modify the way files are watched in the system.
devServer.watchConfig.extensions: [DEPRECATED] A list of extensions to watch for changes.
devServer.watchConfig.directories: [DEPRECATED] A list of directories to watch for changes.
esbuild.esBuildPath: An absolute path to the esbuild executable, on Windows it must include the .exe extension.
esbuild.version: A Semantic versioning version of an esbuild release, this must match a package in the npm js registry.
esbuild.ecmaVersion: Any target defined by esbuild, check https://esbuild.github.io/api/#target.
esbuild.injects: A list of files to inject at the transformation phase, this is injected only at build time.
esbuild.externals: Third party libraries that you want esbuild to ignore (i.e. bare specifiers), eg. excluding lit from the bundle from 'import { LitElement from 'lit'}'.
esbuild.fileLoaders: An object with file extensions and the kind of loaders you want for them see https://esbuild.github.io/content-types.
esbuild.jsxAutomatic: Tells esbuild to automatically inject the jsx function helpers h and Fragment and react equivalents.
esbuild.jsxImportSource: Tells esbuild to set the source of the jsx helper imports e.g. Do not set it if you're using react.
build: Configurations for perla's production build features.
build.outDir: A relative path that tells to output the js files.
build.includes: A relative path or glob that indicates file to copy.
build.excludes: A relative path or glob that indicates file to exclude while copying files.
build.emitEnvFile: Copy the 'PERLA_' prefixed environment variables and output them in the final build as a separate file.
build.esBuildPath: [DEPRECATED] An absolute path to the esbuild executable, on Windows it must include the .exe extension.
build.esbuildVersion: [DEPRECATED] A Semantic versioning version of an esbuild release, this must match a package in the npm js registry.
build.copyPaths: [DEPRECATED] Include/Exclude content to be copied to the final bundle.
build.copyPaths.includes: [DEPRECATED] Files/directories to include in the out directory.
build.copyPaths.excludes: [DEPRECATED] Files/directories to exclude from the out directory, this will override the default exclude list.
build.target: [DEPRECATED] Any target defined by esbuild, check https://esbuild.github.io/api/#target.
build.format: [DEPRECATED] Any format defined by esbuild, check https://esbuild.github.io/api/#format.
build.jsxFactory: [DEPRECATED] This sets the function that is called for each JSX element.
build.jsxFragment: [DEPRECATED] This sets the function that is called for each JSX fragment.
build.externals: [DEPRECATED] Third party libraries that you want esbuild to ignore (i.e. bare specifiers).
build.injects: [DEPRECATED] A list of files to inject at the transformation phase.
build.fileLoaders: [DEPRECATED] An object with file extensions and the kind of loaders you want for them.
testing: Configuration to run perla's testing features powered by playwright.
testing.browsers: browsers to run the testing suites with.
testing.includes: A relative path or globbing pattern to include test files.
testing.excludes: A relative path or globbing pattern to exclude test files.
testing.watch: Run the tests in watch mode (re-run on change).
testing.headless: Run the browser without or with a GUI Display (window).
testing.browserMode: How should the test suites run with several browsers.
testing.fable: Fable Compiler configuration options for testing.
testing.fable.project: A relative path to the Fable project to compile for testing.
testing.fable.extension: The extension to use for compiled js files in testing.
testing.fable.sourceMaps: Enable/Disable Fable source maps for testing.
testing.fable.outDir: A relative path that tells to output the js files for testing.
testing.fable.autoStart: [DEPRECATED] Enable/Disable the Fable compilation at the start of the dev server for testing.
testing.testFramework: The test framework to use, this is used to generate the test runner.
testing.frameworkOptions: key-value object to pass to the test framework.
runConfiguration: [DEPRECATED] Whether perla runs in production or dev mode, production is (and should be) the default.
devDependencies: [DEPRECATED] The main index file to be processed by perla, this file should be outside of the static mounted paths.
packages: [DEPRECATED] A list of third party packages with the URL to their source, the key of the object can be any string, not necessarily the name of the package.
